summary: Richmond Public Schools urges the FCC to preserve E-Rate program to maintain essential broadband infrastructure for public education. Richmond Public Schools highlights the value of E-Rate funding for maintaining and upgrading broadband infrastructure, emphasizing the need for continued investment to support educational technology and ensure student access to reliable internet services. The school district provides specific figures on the amount of E-Rate support received and the long-term savings achieved through infrastructure upgrades. The comment urges preserving the E-Rate program to maintain reliable broadband infrastructure for schools and libraries.
